Heard on I.A. No.18036/2025, which is third application under Section 430(1) of BNSS/389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant-Aadil Ahmed.

This appeal is filed being aggrieved of the judgment dated 30/09/2022 passed by the learned Special Judge, POCSO Act, Anuppur (MP) in SPL Case No.53/2018 whereby appellant stands convicted and sentenced as under:-
 Conviction Sente  
 Section Act Imprisonment F  
 R.I. for 05   363 IPC Rs.5,000  years   R.I. for 05   366 IPC Rs.5,000  years   R.I. for 05   368 IPC Rs.5,000  years   R.I. for 20   376(2)(n) IPC Rs.5,000  years   R.I. for 20   5(l)/6 POCSO years Rs.5,000 Aadil Ahmed vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 31 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122915626/
1  2  Reading from para-23 of the deposition of the victim (PW-2), it is pointed out that victim has not supported prosecution's case.
There is no DNA report on record.
It is submitted that it is a fit case for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
There are good chances of success in appeal.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.
Shri Ajay Tamrakar, learned Public Prosecutor for the State, support the impugned judgment and opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence.

Taking these facts into consideration and also considering the fact that there appears to be good chances of success in appeal, without commenting on merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of jail sentence of appellant and release him on bail.
Accordingly, I.A. No.18036/2025 is allowed and disposed of.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for appearance of the present appellant as well as all other appellants in connected appeals, before the trial Court on 13th May, 2026 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court which shall not be more than once in a calendar year,
the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of appellant shall remain suspended and he be 3 CRA-10523-2022 released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
Certified copy as per rules.
